description_en: Queries the recoverable time range of a sandbox instance
description_zh: 查看沙箱实例的可恢复时间范围
name: DescribeSandboxRecoveryTime

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup schedule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437215.html operation to obtain the ID of the backup schedule. If you set this parameter to the backup schedule ID obtained by calling the DescribeBackupPlanList operation, the dbs prefix must be removed. Otherwise, the call fails.

If your instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, you can https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html to automatically add the instance to DBS and obtain the ID of the backup schedule
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437215.html接口获取该参数。获取到的备份计划ID传入时，必须去掉前缀dbs，否则将调用失败。

若您的实例为RDS MySQL，请通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html功能，将RDS自动添加至DBS中，即可获取备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

BackupPlanId.description_en: The backup schedule of the sandbox instance

RecoveryBeginTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range during which the sandbox instance can be restored. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
RecoveryBeginTime.description_zh: 可恢复的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RecoveryEndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which the sandbox instance can be restored. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
RecoveryEndTime.description_zh: 可恢复的截止时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
